unresolved_intent.decision: any json.JSONDecodeError/ValueError from json.loads, and any non-list top-level value (dict, number, string, bool, null), is treated identically as ERROR
unresolved_intent.rationale: spec says 'not a JSON array' covers both malformed JSON and well-formed-but-wrong-shape JSON; no distinct error messages requested

unresolved_intent.decision: a non-string array element (e.g. 42, null, {}) is ERROR, not coerced to string or skipped
unresolved_intent.rationale: spec explicitly lists 'a non-string element' alongside unknown event strings as an ERROR case

unresolved_intent.decision: transitions modeled as an explicit 4-entry dict keyed by (state,event) rather than nested if/else, and lookup misses trigger ERROR rather than a default state
unresolved_intent.rationale: makes totality visually auditable (all 2x2 combinations present) and keeps 'never silently ignored' true by construction — a KeyError-equivalent (dict miss) is checked and always redirected to ERROR

unresolved_intent.decision: stray leading/trailing whitespace or a trailing newline in stdin is tolerated because json.loads already ignores it; no manual trim/strip added
unresolved_intent.rationale: spec doesn't mention whitespace handling; relying on the standard JSON parser's built-in tolerance avoids adding unrequested logic
